policies.title: Passwords never expire or expire after more than a year
policies.description: Checks that PASS_MAX_DAYS is between 1 and 365.
policies.rationale: Rotation limits how long a leaked password stays useful (the 365-day bound is this project's choice).
policies.absence_note: Distributions commonly ship 99999 (never) when unset: treated as a failure.
policies.remediation: Set PASS_MAX_DAYS 365 or lower, per local policy.

policies.title: Passwords can be changed immediately after a change
policies.description: Checks that PASS_MIN_DAYS is at least 1.
policies.rationale: A minimum age stops users cycling through history to reuse an old password.
policies.absence_note: Default is 0 (UNVERIFIED), which allows instant re-change: treated as a failure.

policies.title: Users get little warning before password expiry
policies.description: Checks that PASS_WARN_AGE is at least 7 days.
policies.rationale: Short notice leads to lockouts and rushed, weaker passwords.
policies.absence_note: Default is distribution specific; result is unknown.

policies.title: Password hashing method is weak
policies.description: Checks that new passwords use SHA-512 or yescrypt.
policies.rationale: MD5, DES and SHA-256-without-rounds hashes are fast to attack offline.
policies.absence_note: Default hash depends on the distribution and its PAM stack; result is unknown.

policies.title: Many failed login attempts are allowed per session
policies.description: Checks that LOGIN_RETRIES is 5 or lower.
policies.absence_note: Default is distribution specific; result is unknown.

policies.title: Default umask leaves new files group- or world-writable/readable
policies.description: Checks that UMASK is 027 or stricter.
policies.rationale: A permissive default creates files other users can read or modify.
policies.absence_note: Default umask is 022 on many distributions (UNVERIFIED); result is unknown when the file does not set it.
